linear_self_attention.why: the contract allows TF32 operands for S and the numerator; on all 20 Trn2 cases T_emp = Q / BW_emp (the TF32 compute term never binds); the declared mode only makes the target stricter, never inflates efficiency

manual_nki_efficiency_frozen_Q.source: results/TRN2/csv/rmsnorm_default.csv nki_ms (formal native Trn2 results, main #322) on the 20 frozen fp16 cases

rmsnorm.minimum_correction_if_wanted: a central arithmetic_modes decision (like M4 radix_sort_Q): approved Q override for rmsnorm, Q = (2 * n + K) * dtype_size, applied to every device at the same time AFTER the running campaigns finish (arithmetic_modes.yaml is pinned by their scoring bindings; changing it mid-run refuses formal resumes); never a Trn2-only change
rmsnorm.why: a uniform x1.5 per-operator scale of a frozen, shared definition (same on B200/GH200/MI300X); within-operator comparisons (models, Base vs Enhanced, rounds) are unchanged; efficiency > 1 is possible and is kept as an audit flag, never clipped; T_emp is not used during the run (prompts and feedback carry no SOL value), so a central correction can be applied post hoc
